executive_summary_zh: 今天高信号内容集中在两类：一是代码智能从“聊天式助手”转向“为代理和人类提供代码库理解基础设施”，二是组织开始把 AI 产出的下游瓶颈从写代码转向评审与合规分流。
Sourcegraph 宣布停止 Cody，技术方向明确转向大型代码库理解、检索与控制层，这对平台团队判断“自建代理栈需要什么底座”很有参考价值。
另一篇 Sourcegraph 文章更具落地性：它把 PR 审核拆成 Ship/Show/Ask 三类，并尝试用代理做路由与证据生成，直接对应 AI 编码普及后的工程流程重构。
executive_summary_en: Today's strongest signal is a two-part shift: code intelligence is moving from chat-style assistants toward repo-understanding infrastructure for both humans and agents, and the organizational bottleneck is moving from code generation to review routing and governance.

Sourcegraph's Cody sunset is notable not as product news, but as a strategic admission that the durable layer is large-repo understanding, retrieval, and control rather than another standalone coding assistant.

The more actionable piece is Sourcegraph's PR approval bot write-up, which operationalizes Ship/Show/Ask review paths and uses an agent to classify changes and provide evidence—exactly the kind of workflow redesign backend and platform leads should expect as AI coding scales.

items.title: Keeping code moving with clearer review expectations | Sourcegraph
items.author: Constantin Nicolae
items.summary_zh: Sourcegraph 描述了一个内部 PR 路由实验：随着代理生成更多代码，真正的瓶颈转移到评审阶段，因此他们引入基于 Ship/Show/Ask 的分类体系，让代理先阅读 diff 和上下文，再给出需要“可直接合并、合并后展示、合并前必须询问”的建议与证据。
items.summary_en: Sourcegraph describes an internal PR routing experiment: as coding agents increase code output, the real bottleneck shifts to review. They applied a Ship/Show/Ask framework and had an agent inspect the diff and surrounding code to recommend whether a change can ship directly, should be shown after merge, or must be reviewed before merge, along with supporting evidence.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是泛泛而谈的“AI 改变开发”，而是工程组织层面的具体控制面设计：当代码生成提速后，评审、审批和上下文切换会成为新瓶颈。对平台/后端负责人来说，这篇文章提供了一个可复制的最小流程改造模板：先做风险分流，再把人的注意力集中在高风险变更上。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is not generic 'AI changes development' commentary; it's a concrete control-plane design for engineering organizations. Once code generation speeds up, review, approvals, and reviewer context switching become the bottleneck. For backend/platform leaders, it offers a reproducible minimal workflow redesign: risk-route changes first, then concentrate human attention on the ones that actually need it.
key_takeaways_zh: Ship/Show/Ask 把单一“必须审批”规则拆成不同风险路径，更适合 AI 时代的高吞吐变更流。
代理的价值不只是给出结论，而是读取 diff 与周边代码后提供可审计证据，帮助团队逐步建立自动路由信任。
key_takeaways_en: Ship/Show/Ask decomposes a single mandatory-approval rule into risk-based paths, which fits AI-era high-throughput change flows much better.
The agent's value is not only classification but also evidence generation from the diff and surrounding code, making review automation auditable and easier to trust incrementally.

items.title: Sunsetting Sourcegraph Cody and building the future of code intelligence | Sourcegraph
items.author: Dan Adler
items.summary_zh: Sourcegraph 宣布 Cody 将于 2027-01-31 停止服务，并坦承自己两年前没有把 Cody 演进为编码代理，因此决定退出“通用 AI 编码助手”竞争，转而专注于其更有优势的方向：复杂代码库理解、检索与为开发者及其所选代理提供清晰度和控制力。
items.summary_en: Sourcegraph announced that Cody will reach end of life on 2027-01-31. The company explicitly states it chose not to evolve Cody into a coding agent two years ago, and is now exiting the standalone assistant race to focus on what it sees as its durable advantage: understanding complex codebases, retrieval, and providing clarity and control for developers and whichever coding agents they use.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 高信号点不在于产品下线本身，而在于一个早期代码智能公司对价值层的重新判断：在代理主导的时代，长期壁垒可能不是“再做一个助手 UI”，而是代码库索引、语义理解、权限边界、上下文供应和治理能力。这对企业内部自建 AI 编码平台的架构分层很重要。
items.why_it_matters_en: The signal is not the sunset itself but the architectural reassessment from an early code-intelligence company: in an agent-centric era, the durable moat may not be 'another assistant UI' but repository indexing, semantic understanding, permission boundaries, context supply, and governance. That matters directly for enterprises designing their internal AI coding stack.
key_takeaways_zh: Sourcegraph 公开承认 standalone coding assistant 市场已被代理范式重构，代码智能底座比助手前端更具长期价值。
企业团队应把注意力放到“如何给任意代理稳定、安全地提供代码库上下文”这一中间层，而不是绑定某个单一助手产品。
key_takeaways_en: Sourcegraph is explicitly acknowledging that the standalone coding-assistant category has been structurally disrupted by the agent paradigm, making the code-intelligence substrate more valuable than the assistant surface.
Enterprise teams should focus on the middle layer—how to provide stable, secure repository context to any agent—rather than overcommitting to a single assistant product.

what_to_ignore_en: The GitHub Copilot Claude Fable 5.2 changelog is mostly a model-availability and billing/data-retention update, with little methodological, evaluation, or systems-design detail.
Do not confuse routine model rollout news with workflow innovation; today's stronger signal is in code-intelligence layering and review control planes.
